items.title: 6.1 Kinetic theory of gases ke assumptions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.1 with Figs. 6.1 to 6.3, Example 6.1 and thermal equilibrium (PDF 119-124).

blocks.text: Thermodynamics physics ki woh branch hai jo heat (garmi) aur energy ki doosri shaklon ke darmiyan rishte aur ek se doosri mein badalne ko parhti hai. Is mein bari scale (macroscopic) par systems ke behaviour (kaam karne ka tareeqa) ke principle (qaida) aate hain, jaise temperature, pressure aur volume. Isi liye thermodynamics technology mein bohat aham hai, kyun ke hamare istemal ki taqreeban saari kachchi (raw) energy heat ki shakal mein hi nikalti hai. Is chapter mein hum gases ka behaviour aur thermodynamics ke laws, un ki importance aur istemal parhenge.

Kinetic theory of gases physics aur chemistry ki ek basic (jar wali) theory hai. Yeh gases ke behaviour ko un ke chhote particles (nanhe tukre) ki motion (chalna ya hilna) se samjhati hai, aur pressure, temperature aur volume jaisi gas ki properties (khaas baatein) ki bari scale par samajh deti hai.
